periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Nine organizations signed the coordination agreement, but only three represent higher-risk groups. Began an inventory of the intake forms each signer uses. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Invite peer-run and immigrant-serving organizations to sign and start drafting a common intake form.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Signers grew to 12, but only one new signer serves higher-risk groups. Started drafting common intake and release-of-information forms; the release language will need legal review. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Community Health Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Bring three more organizations into the agreement and complete the intake and release drafts for legal review.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Three more organizations signed the coordination agreement, bringing it to 15, but only 6 serve higher-risk groups. Drafted common intake and release-of-information forms, which legal review is still holding. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Bayview Medical Center, Harborview Community Health Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finish legal review and pilot the shared intake form with two signers; invite the Seaport Workers Clinic and two peer-run organizations to sign.
